prompt: scam call center with your friends

ledger.means: The place is a call centre: rows of desks with phones or screens that players use
Players work calls: callers arrive and answer the player's choices (scripted callers are fine)
Friends are in the same call centre at the same time, each seen as a character
Friends share a target (a quota) that the round is won or lost on

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

policy: No ethnic or national caricature, even though games of this kind often set themselves in one country

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
